summary: T-GSE-S1-01/02 static heartbeat: 3 frames, stNum constant 1, sqNum 1/2/3 incrementing, appid 0x1000, confRev 1, TAL 500, numDatSetEntries 3, no IP (L2-direct 0x88b8)

notes: NO-VLAN frame: eth14 + goose-hdr8 + APDU; APDU content 173 bytes -> 61 81 AD; all uint32 fields (TAL/stNum/sqNum/confRev) use MINIMAL BER encoding (libiec61850 ber_encoder compressInteger): TAL=500 -> 81 02 01 f4, stNum=1 -> 85 01 01, confRev=1 -> 88 01 01

offsets computed byte-by-byte: 61@22 80@24 81@68 82@72 83@109 84@152 85@162 86@165 87@168 88@171 89@174 8a@177 ab@180 members@181/185/193 (t field 84 08 wall-clock: tag+length asserted only, never content)
tshark goose.* fields verified against tshark 3.6.14 (FT_BOOLEAN prints 0/1); absent parser falls back to the byte-level asserts which are always present

summary: T-GSE-S2-01 fast retransmit: 1 heartbeat(sqNum=1) + event + 5 fast retransmits (stNum=2 sqNum=0..5), then heartbeat resumes with sqNum=6; content byte-identical across retransmit frames

notes: design S2 frame sequence: 1 heartbeat (stNum=1,sqNum=1) + event (stNum+1=2, sqNum RESET to 0) + 5 fast retransmits (sqNum 1..5) + frame 8 back to heartbeat rate (sqNum=6); count=8 frames total; event_seq only changes the state machine (stNum+1/sqNum=0) - data bytes stay identical across the burst; design §6.2 S2 table must list all 8 frames (was 7)
all uint32 minimal BER encoding: stNum=2 -> 85 01 02, sqNum -> 86 01 <n>, TAL -> 81 02 01 f4; single member config -> 8a 01 01 ab 04 (num=1, allData content 4B)
sqNum=0 on the first event frame is the mandatory T-GSE-S2-02 reset-semantics assertion

summary: T-GSE-S2-02 dataset change: heartbeat stNum=1 sqNum=1 then event frame stNum=2 sqNum=0 (RESET, not 1), retransmits sqNum 0..2 then heartbeat

notes: CRITICAL: event-change first frame sqNum is 0 (not 1) - state machine reset semantics, mandatory coverage item (minimal encoding: 86 01 00)
stNum is monotonically +1 per event; sqNum restarts at 0 for the event burst

summary: T-GSE-S3-01 test flag set: all frames carry test=true encoded as BER 87 01 01

notes: Wireshark prints goose.test as goose.simulation (FT_BOOLEAN prints 0/1, not true/false - tshark 3.6.14 verified); byte-level 87 01 01 is the FrameAssert fallback that never depends on dissector
test=true chain @167: 87 01 01 (test) 88 01 01 (confRev) 89 01 00 (ndsCom) - offsets lock field positions
mandatory coverage: test flag must be settable and observable in every frame

summary: T-GSE-S3-02 ndsCom flag set: all frames carry ndsCom=true encoded as BER 89 01 01

notes: ndsCom (need-to-stream) sets 0x89 01 01; false sets 0x89 01 00 (see heartbeat for the false case); FT_BOOLEAN prints 0/1 in tshark
ndsCom=true chain @167: 87 01 00 (test) 88 01 01 (confRev) 89 01 01 (ndsCom)
observation: receiver treats ndsCom=true data as not-ready - flag must round-trip byte-exactly

summary: T-GSE-S4-01 VLAN: TPID 0x8100 + TCI 0x8064 (prio 4 / id 100), EtherType 0x88b8 shifted +4, APDU at offset 26

notes: VLAN header sits between MACs and EtherType; TCI = prio(4)<<13 | dei(1b) | vid 100 = 0x8064

all APDU offsets shift by +4 vs the non-VLAN case (offset 26 here vs 22); GOOSE Length @20 = 00 ab (171) proves design 9.4 VLAN formula: frame length - 18 - 8 = APDU; APDU content=160, long-form header=3, APDU total=163, Length=8+163=171

summary: T-GSE-S5-01 multi-type data values: Boolean x2, Integer x2, Unsigned, FloatingPoint, BitString x2, VisibleString x2 (10 members) - all BER member tags byte-verified, numDatSetEntries 10

notes: mandatory coverage: Boolean/Integer/Real(FloatingPoint)/BitString each >1 instance - 2 booleans, 2 int32, 1 float32 (=IEC 61850 FloatingPoint/Real), 2 bit_strings, 2 visible_strings; numDatSetEntries 10

BIT STRING 0x84: len = 1 + ceil(n/8), padding byte FIRST = (byteSize*8)-bitLength (ber_encoder.c) - 8-bit value fe -> 84 02 00 fe (padding 0, NOT 1); 4-bit value 0f -> 84 02 04 f0 (padding 4, bits left-aligned)

multi-instance field asserts: goose.boolean/integer output is per-packet comma-joined (tshark: 1,0) so exact-value equality is impossible - use nonzero (existence) here; exact bytes are proven by the frame asserts above
FloatingPoint 0x87: len = 1 + width/8 = 5 bytes (1 exponent-width byte 08 + 4 mantissa bytes), NOT IEEE754 bare 4B - frame asserts the 87 05 08 prefix; goose.real decodes to 2.5 (FT_DOUBLE)

summary: T-GSE-S7-01 multi-dataset: 6 members (bool/int32/uint32/float32/bit_string/visible_string), numDatSetEntries 6 == allData member count

notes: numDatSetEntries=6 and allData (0xab) contains exactly 6 members - mandatory coverage: multi-dataset with numDatSetEntries > 1
member order preserved as listed; each type has its BER discriminator byte (0x83/0x85/0x86/0x87/0x84/0x8a); minimal encoding: int32 42 -> 85 01 2a, bit_string aa -> 84 02 00 aa (padding 0)

summary: T-GSE-S6-01 no-IP proof: frame carries ethernet 0x88b8 directly (no IPv4 0x0800 / IPv6 0x86dd), APDU 0x61 starts at byte 22 - GOOSE is L2-terminated

notes: byte-level no-IP proof: offset 12 = 88 b8 (EtherType is GOOSE, not 0x0800/0x86dd) AND offset 22 = 61 (APDU first byte, not 0x45 IPv4 first nibble) - proves the Eth header is directly followed by the GOOSE APDU with NO IP layer in between

frame.protocols exact value is environment-dependent (eth:ethertype:goose with the goose dissector, eth:data without) so only existence (nonzero) is asserted - the two byte asserts are the dissector-independent proof, lower-level than field assertions and green in both environments
GOOSE is Ethernet-multicast with no IP encapsulation - IPv4/IPv6 marked N/A in the testcase doc 1.5

summary: negative: non-contiguous sqNum - retransmit sequence jumps/duplicates sqNum (violates monotonically +1 within a burst)

notes: sqNum must be contiguous (+1) within a change burst or heartbeat run; a step/jump is invalid (design 9.1)
guards the T-GSE-S2-02 'change first frame sqNum=0 then +1' hard rule so generators cannot silently skip numbers

summary: negative: stNum wrap-around - stNum must never regress/wrap (0xFFFFFFFF -> 0), violating the change counter monotonicity

notes: stNum is a monotonic change counter; wrap (0xFFFFFFFF -> 0) would mislead subscribers into treating a new version as old (design 9.1)
start_stnum 4294967295 = 0xFFFFFFFF triggers the validator on the out-of-range/regression path (design 10.1 goose_stnum_override: start read from config, never wrap)
